definitions.explanation: The handing over of something from one party to another — money, goods, documents, or information. A formal word, common in legal, business, and grammar contexts. Takes する.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金銭|きんせん}→金銭：02684_kinsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{授受|じゅじゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an exchange of money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{授受|じゅじゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please hand over and receive documents at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧な⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{授受|じゅじゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われていた→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is suspicion that an illegal transfer of funds was taking place.

notes:
Composed of {授|じゅ} (to give, confer) + {受|じゅ} (to receive). Refers to a two-way handover. A formal, written-register word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{金銭|きんせん}→金銭：02684_kinsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{授受|じゅじゅ}: the exchange of money
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{授受|じゅじゅ}: the handover of documents
- {授受|じゅじゅ}⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧: giving-and-receiving verbs (a grammar term for ⟦あげる→あげる：00546_ageru⟧・⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧・⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やり{取|と}り→やり取り：07702_yaritori⟧: exchange — far more casual and everyday
- ⟦{受|う}け{渡|わた}し→受け渡し：22763_ukewatashi⟧: delivery / handover — emphasizes the physical passing of goods

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: 授受していませんでした
